title: Tacking and gybing a yacht: a step-by-step guide
h1: Tacking and gybing, step by step
lead: Tacking and gybing are how a yacht changes tack, and both go smoothly when everyone knows the calls and their job. Here is each manoeuvre from the first call to the final trim.
description: How to tack and gybe a sailing yacht: the calls, crew jobs, winches without riding turns, a controlled gybe, getting out of irons and tips for catamarans.
summary: The helm leads with clear calls and waits until every crew member answers "Ready".
In a tack, release the old sheet as the headsail backs, then pull the new one in fast.
In a gybe, bring the boom to the centre first, so it crosses only a short way.
Catamarans lose speed in a tack, so build speed first and turn firmly.
